findings.title: Failed mandatory min_score still yields CONDITIONALLY_QUALIFIED and is returned by get_qualified()
findings.description: _evaluate_qualification sets passed=False when any criterion is below min_score (e.g. Insurance/Bonding min 7). QUALIFIED correctly requires passed and total>=60, but the elif total_score>=50 branch does not require passed, so a sub that fails Insurance with 0 still becomes CONDITIONALLY_QUALIFIED when other scores pad the total to 50. get_qualified() includes CONDITIONALLY_QUALIFIED, so the failed-min contractor is returned for award/shortlist. Distinct from prior TK-L04 (EMR/documents ignored when mins are met) and unbounded max_score inflation.
findings.impact: A subcontractor who fails mandatory Insurance/Bonding (or Safety) minimums still appears in get_qualified() and can be awarded work. Lien/bonding/insurance exposure on the project.
findings.attack_path:
1. Operator deploys SubcontractorPrequalification as the live prequal/award gate (Quick Start get_qualified).
2. Attacker is a bidder (or colluding scorer) whose Insurance/Bonding score is 0 (below min 7) while other criteria are maxed to total 50.
3. score_application → _evaluate_qualification sets passed=False but elif total>=50 stamps CONDITIONALLY_QUALIFIED.
4. get_qualified(trade) returns the contractor for award.
findings.remediation: Require passed on every branch: elif passed and app.total_score >= 50 for CONDITIONALLY_QUALIFIED. Exclude CONDITIONALLY_QUALIFIED from get_qualified() unless an explicit include_conditional flag is set. Clamp scores to [0, max_score].
